author: akritkbehera
body:
#### PR description:

ROOT 6.41 headers no longer include `<iostream>` for you. Validation/RecoParticleFlow/src/Comparator.cc uses cerr/endl without including it, so it fails to compile in CMSSW_20_1_ROOT6_X. This PR adds the missing include; nothing else changes
title: [ROOT6.41] Add missing #include <iostream> in Validation/RecoParticleFlow Comparator.cc
